meta.name: gpt-taste
meta.description: Elite UX/UI & Advanced GSAP Motion Engineer. Enforces Python-driven true randomization for layout variance, strict AIDA page structure, wide editorial typography (bans 6-line wraps), gapless bento grids, strict GSAP ScrollTriggers (pinning, stacking, scrubbing), inline micro-images, and massive section spacing.

copy.tagline: 打造高级UI动效与排版布局
copy.tagline_en: Create advanced UI animations and typographic layouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you pursue top-tier visual experience and GSAP motion design.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成符合 AWWWARDS 水准的网页设计代码，包括宽屏英雄区、无空隙的 Bento 网格、GSAP 滚动动画和悬停动效，并强制使用 Python 模拟随机化来避免重复布局。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成网页 UI 代码（如 React/HTML 页面）时触发，尤其是需要高端设计、动画或网格布局的场景。

say.text: 帮我设计一个创意作品集的首页，要有宽屏英雄区和 Bento 网格。
生成一个产品落地页，使用 GSAP 滚动触发和悬停动效。
做一个品牌展示页，要求无空隙网格和行内图片排版。
say.note: Claude 会确保网格完美填充，并在标题中嵌入小图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates AWWWARDS-level web design code, including wide hero sections, gapless bento grids, GSAP scroll animations and hover effects, and enforces Python-driven randomization to avoid layout repetition.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate web UI code (e.g., React/HTML pages), especially for high-end design, animations, or grid layouts.

say_en.text: Design a creative portfolio homepage with a wide hero and bento grid.
say_en.note: Claude outputs code with AIDA structure, GSAP animations, and randomized layout.

say_en.text: Generate a product landing page with GSAP scroll triggers and hover effects.
say_en.note: Claude applies ScrollTrigger, card stacking, and other advanced animations.

say_en.text: Create a brand showcase page with gapless grid and inline typography images.
say_en.note: Claude ensures perfect grid filling and embeds small images inside headings.
